name: site_id
label: Site
help: The site, from the sites this API token can open. You can also map a site ID (pa_...) from an earlier module.

name: name
label: Name
help: Display name, max 100 characters. Defaults to the target hostname

name: kind
label: Kind
help: What to check. http requires a response with the expected status from url. keyword also requires keyword in the body. tcp connects to host and port. dns requires host to resolve

name: url
label: URL
help: Full URL including https://, for http and keyword checks. Defaults to the site's home page for site checks. Private addresses are refused

name: host
label: Host
help: Hostname without scheme, like example.com, for tcp and dns checks. Private addresses are refused

name: port
label: Port
help: TCP port from 1 to 65535, required for tcp checks

name: keyword
label: Keyword
help: Text the response body must contain, case sensitive, max 200 characters. Required for keyword checks

name: expected_status
label: Expected Status
help: HTTP status code that counts as up, from 100 to 599. Default 200. For http and keyword checks

name: http_method
label: HTTP Method
help: HTTP method used to probe: GET (default) or HEAD. For http and keyword checks

name: interval_seconds
label: Interval Seconds
help: Seconds between probes, from 30 to 86400, and at least your plan minimum (Free 300, Pro 60, Business 30). Default 300 or the plan minimum if higher

name: timeout_seconds
label: Timeout Seconds
help: Seconds before a probe counts as failed, from 1 to 30. Default 20

name: public
label: Public
help: Allow this check to be shown on public status pages. Default false
